steps.name: svg-text
steps.expr: const bad=[]; document.querySelectorAll('.fig svg').forEach((s,si)=>{const sb=s.getBoundingClientRect(); const ts=[...s.querySelectorAll('text')].filter(t=>!t.getAttribute('transform')); ts.forEach((t,i)=>{const b=t.getBoundingClientRect(); if(b.left<sb.left-1||b.right>sb.right+1||b.top<sb.top-1||b.bottom>sb.bottom+1) bad.push('clip svg'+si+': '+t.textContent.slice(0,30)); for(let j=i+1;j<ts.length;j++){const c=ts[j].getBoundingClientRect(); if(b.left<c.right-1&&c.left<b.right-1&&b.top<c.bottom-1&&c.top<b.bottom-1) bad.push('overlap svg'+si+': '+t.textContent.slice(0,20)+' / '+ts[j].textContent.slice(0,20));}});}); return bad.length? bad.join(' || ') : 'svg text clean ('+document.querySelectorAll('.fig svg text').length+' labels)'
